name: corekit
description: Two plugins for Claude Code and Codex: a project workflow (corecrew) and a model and effort picker (coremodel).

plugins.name: corecrew
plugins.description: Run every project the same way: start from an interview, work with a crew of agents, keep the docs in a private repo.

plugins.name: coremodel
plugins.description: Spends only what each prompt needs: picks the model and effort level, and asks before the costly ones.
